╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌
 Context

 hello.py has a single greet(name) helper. Add a matching
 farewell(name) so the module covers both ends of the conversation.

 Change

 In hello.py, append below greet:

 def farewell(name):
     return "bye " + name

 Same shape as greet: single arg, string concatenation, no docstring.

 Verification

 python3 -c "import hello; print(hello.farewell('alex'))" → bye alex
